summary: dellemc.openmanage in 10.1.0 adds session ID authentication for iDRAC, OME and OME-Modular, and a new ome_session module to create and delete OME sessions.
questions: Can I authenticate to iDRAC with a session ID instead of a password?
How do I create an OpenManage Enterprise session from Ansible?

answer_card.title: Session-based auth for openmanage
answer_card.answer_md: Session ID authentication is supported for iDRAC, OpenManage Enterprise and OME-Modular. The new `ome_session` module creates and deletes sessions on OME and OME-Modular.
